gaps: Bridge live requests require separate approval and were not exercised without an approved token.
Public Research data is regional time series, not property-level listing inventory.

novel_features.name: Client affordability gap
novel_features.description: Compare household income with Zillow's regional homeowner-income-needed estimate.
novel_features.rationale: Joins a client-specific input with the latest sourced regional estimate while preserving date and provenance.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent must turn a generic affordability estimate into a client-specific answer.

novel_features.name: Rent/value yield proxy
novel_features.description: Join ZORI and ZHVI on a common date for a transparent gross rent-to-value proxy.
novel_features.rationale: Requires aligning two independently released Zillow series before calculating the proxy.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for quick, explainable rent-versus-value comparisons without pretending the proxy is net yield.

novel_features.name: Supply absorption ratio
novel_features.description: Join inventory and sales nowcast into an approximate months-of-inventory ratio.
novel_features.rationale: The useful signal appears only after aligning stock and sales-flow datasets on a common date.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs a compact supply-balance signal with its approximation stated.

novel_features.name: Market turning points
novel_features.description: Find dated slope sign reversals across temperature, inventory, days pending, and ZHVI.
novel_features.rationale: Requires scanning multiple normalized time series rather than reading a latest-value endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent must identify when a market changed direction, not merely its current level.

novel_features.name: Weighted regional shortlist
novel_features.description: Rank regions with explicit user weights and visible min-max-normalized components.
novel_features.rationale: Combines several Zillow series under user-owned priorities while exposing every normalized component.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for relocation or market-screening work where ranking criteria must remain auditable.

novel_features.name: Sync quality audit
novel_features.description: Detect missing observations, duplicate regions, coverage gaps, and large monthly jumps.
novel_features.rationale: Audits normalized source data before downstream conclusions are trusted.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before analysis when freshness, gaps, or anomalous changes could invalidate a conclusion.

novel_features.name: Market breadth
novel_features.description: Measure rising, falling, and unchanged regions by state or geography type.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates direction across every covered region instead of over-weighting a headline metro.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to tell whether a trend is broad or isolated.

novel_features.name: Buy versus rent break-even
novel_features.description: Run a visible-assumption ownership-versus-rent cash-flow scenario.
novel_features.rationale: Combines regional Zillow values and rents with explicit financing and ownership assumptions.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs an inspectable scenario rather than a black-box recommendation.

novel_features.name: Negotiation leverage
novel_features.description: Combine price cuts, sale-to-list ratio, days pending, and inventory into an explainable score.
novel_features.rationale: Buyer leverage is clearer when listing behavior, sale outcomes, market time, and supply are evaluated together.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for buyer preparation when every score component must be shown.

novel_features.name: Price-tier spread
novel_features.description: Compare bottom-, middle-, and top-tier ZHVI growth.
novel_features.rationale: Aligns three separate tier datasets to reveal divergence hidden by a single market average.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when affordability tiers may be moving differently from the headline market.

novel_features.name: Demand pressure
novel_features.description: Combine rental demand and for-sale market momentum with component-level evidence.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-market pressure only appears after joining renter demand with for-sale signals.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent must compare rental and ownership demand in one sourced view.

novel_features.name: New-construction gap
novel_features.description: Compare new-construction pricing and sales activity with typical regional home value.
novel_features.rationale: Aligns new-build price and sales series with the broader ZHVI benchmark.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to quantify the new-build premium and activity context.

novel_features.name: Client-ready market brief
novel_features.description: Compose deterministic Markdown or JSON briefs from sourced regional metrics.
novel_features.rationale: Builds a reproducible brief from the same evidence-backed calculations exposed by the CLI.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent must hand a human a concise brief without inventing narrative facts.

novel_features.name: Formula and provenance explainer
novel_features.description: Show formulas, datasets, freshness behavior, and caveats for compound commands.
novel_features.rationale: Makes derived metrics auditable before an agent repeats them to a client or employer.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before relying on a compound score or scenario in consequential work.

narrative.headline: Official Zillow Research data, normalized for explainable housing-market decisions.
narrative.value_prop: Sync public Zillow Research time series, compare regions, and build sourced affordability, supply, demand, negotiation, and relocation analysis. Core commands never scrape Zillow.com; optional Bridge requests remain separately authorized and uncached.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public Zillow Research commands require no authentication. Bridge access is optional and requires an approved BRIDGE_ACCESS_TOKEN; the CLI sends it only as bearer authorization and never caches Bridge responses.

quickstart.comment: Confirm paths and local runtime health without credentials.
Resolve a human place name against official dataset coverage.
Turn several official series into an explainable buyer-leverage view.

troubleshoots.symptom: A region name is ambiguous or not found.
troubleshoots.fix: Run zillow-pp-cli region resolve "<city, state>" --metric zhvi --agent and reuse the returned region ID.

troubleshoots.symptom: Local mode says a dataset is unavailable.
troubleshoots.fix: Run zillow-pp-cli sync market --metrics all --agent, then retry with --data-source local.
Honor the reported Retry-After value, reduce request frequency with --rate-limit, and retry later.
Obtain dataset approval first, then set BRIDGE_ACCESS_TOKEN in the invoking process environment.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for read-only US housing-market research, regional comparisons, relocation screens, affordability scenarios, and client-ready evidence briefs based on public Zillow Research data. Prefer it when formulas, dates, source URLs, and caveats must remain visible.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to scrape Zillow.com or automate consumer listing pages.
Do not use it to publish, edit, contact, bid on, or transact on a property.
Do not treat derived scores or scenarios as appraisal, lending, legal, tax, or investment advice.
Do not use Bridge commands without explicit dataset approval.

recipes.title: Buyer negotiation brief
recipes.explanation: Shows leverage score, every component, source dates, and caveats.

recipes.title: Buy-versus-rent scenario
recipes.explanation: Compares cash flow using visible financing, growth, tax, insurance, maintenance, and transaction assumptions.

recipes.title: Regional shortlist
recipes.explanation: Ranks candidate markets while exposing normalized components and user-supplied weights.

recipes.title: Compact sourced snapshot
recipes.explanation: Keeps only the region, core metrics, and evidence fields for low-context agent use.

recipes.title: Offline SQL
recipes.command: zillow-pp-cli sql "SELECT metric, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM observations GROUP BY metric" --agent
recipes.explanation: Queries normalized observations locally after sync with a read-only SQL gate.
